message.subject: Walkthrough collaboration on practical AI tools with EDXSO
message.email_body: Using GPT-6 Astra and Higgsfield to generate interactive websites from simple prompts is a highly practical technique. Your video on creating cinematic websites using GPT-6 Astra caught our attention because it demonstrates how complex web design can be simplified. At EDXSO, we help school leaders use technology for sustainable growth. We propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed, helping educators leverage AI tools. Would you like to see a one-page outline before deciding?
message.dm: Your video on creating cinematic websites stood out. We want to discuss an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers to explore school-based AI.
